notes.title: Driver's Diary of August
notes.content:
[h2][b]August highlights ✨[/b][/h2][p]August was a busy month behind the scenes, and we couldn’t resist sharing one exciting news: Road Kings, our upcoming on-road trucking simulation coming in 2026. 🚚[/p][p][/p][h3][b]MARK SEPTEMBER 4 IN YOUR CALENDAR 📅[/b][/h3][p]Next Thursday, get ready for a triple dose of content: SnowRunner’s Season 16, the Rebuild Expansion for RoadCraft, and a brand-new Ford DLC for Expeditions all launching on the same day![/p][p][/p][h3][b]📸 NEW VP CONTEST: FPS VIEW[/b][/h3][p]This month, we’re focusing on first-person perspective screenshots from SnowRunner, RoadCraft, and Expeditions.[/p][p]Hop in the driver’s seat and show us the world through your eyes whether it’s a rugged trail, a flooded road, or a massive construction site, we want your most immersive shots! 👀[/p][p]Basically, we want to see what’s on your windshield![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/7863a9125d9222fbb82eb995907b7870b2bfa2e4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Post your entry on the Discord [b]“contest” channel[/b] by September 16 for a chance to win a key for SnowRunner, RoadCraft, or Expeditions on any platform except Switch 🎁.[/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to edit your images and include as many photos as you like, [b]but all in one entry![/b][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FVkZkcjKGmy" style="button" buttoncolor="#6753fd"]Join here[/url][/p][p]Let’s see the road from your cabin![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/08e557dbe57497c981879c6ea15fad29c1467606.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]❄️ SnowRunner[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]🎉 LET’S CELEBRATE YEAR 5 PASS![/b][/h3][p]Exciting news! September 4 also marks the start of the Year 5 Pass![/p][p]We’re happy to keep this journey going with you, thanks for all your support. 💙[/p][p]At launch, you’ll also grab your instant skin rewards. Check them out!
[/p][carousel][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/b89eb183e9f3b47c9371fe085c1753f37c0dcc63.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/81c606dfee17d4e933131e5525d3d1283157948f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/6f182316c5a2fc8d100d15cc5e463aedbf2c95b0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/5f836c14b762d29db82e982697d92755bc31088c.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]
[b]⚡ SEASON 16 IS JUST AROUND THE CORNER[/b][/h3][p]Closing out Year 4 in style, Season 16: High Voltage takes you to Washington State! ⚡[/p][p]Fix the infrastructure, power up the hydro plant, and get ready for new challenges![/p][p][/p][p]You will explore three new maps and tackle challenges with three new trucks:[/p][list][*][p][b]HIB Billert 1980[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]PLAD 440 “Buddy”[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sleiter ST 833 “Chimera”[/b][/p][/*][/list][carousel][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/2f1a11f0cacf64d18b494a9d1125ccbeb132df76.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/fb53b9da49c154627f31e457a36fedf213d497fe.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/9ccef9e21ea38e1ac0da299ba2714ba5bf7b76b3.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]This new Season will be live on September 4 too![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🛠️ SWITCH & MAC: END OF SUPPORT[/b][/h3][p]Hey Runners! Just so you know: Switch and Mac won’t get live-ops updates anymore (crossplay stays until November ✅).[/p][p]Multiplayer is still here, mods are still working on Switch and from now on, the game is yours to shape on these platforms![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/9d931d574a7a57d8247b87d5fb9c49d8284693d6.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]🚧 RoadCraft[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]🛠️ REBUILD EXPANSION IS COMING VERY SOON![/b][/h3][p]Over 100 new missions are coming your way on September 4 in two brand-new maps: Contamination and Wash Out.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/b750b0c4029002e7cddf97184b724fedd4c39422.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/3cdb11acec20dde966ee9bcc6090be499d1f0a3b.png"][/img][/carousel][p]→ Roll out with new vehicles like the massive [b]Vostok MU-97 Ant Bridge Layer,[/b] plus four variants:[/p][list][*][p]Tayga 6455B Bridge Layer[/p][/*][*][p]Arminger Thunder “Expeditions”[/p][/*][*][p]Tuz 119 Mutt[/p][/*][*][p]Mule T1 Trailblazer[/p][/*][/list][p]The Rebuild Expansion content is available for Rebuild Expansion owners and can also be purchased as a standalone DLC.[/p][p]All players will get the new difficulty options, which let you push your builds further with fuel management, gearboxes, convoy coordination and economy tweaks. You’ll also receive the Wayfarer ST7050 Fuel Truck and various fixes and improvements. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎵 AUGUST RHYMED WITH PATCH 3 AND PTS[/b][/h3][p]August was about polish with Patch 3 (bug fixes and small additions).[/p][p][/p][p]We also opened the Public Test Server on Steam for all RoadCraft owners featuring the upcoming Rebuild Expansion content![/p][p]👉 [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcommunity.focus-entmt.com%2Ffocus-entertainment%2Froadcraft%2Fblogs%2F249-the-roadcraft-public-test-server-is-now-live" style="button" buttoncolor="#cfb402"]Patch notes here[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]And don’t forget[/b]: we’ve got a dedicated PTS channel on our Discord. Just grab the “RoadCraft PTS” role to join the convo![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FnXBaAWDy98" style="button" buttoncolor="#6753fd"]Join here[/url]
[/p][h1][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/3b479469a94fda87d067b8914e5227f41a726603.png"][/img][b]🧭Expeditions[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]🛻 NEW FORD TRUCKS JOIN THE ADVENTURE![/b][/h3][p]Get ready! The Ford DLC arrives on September 4, adding two new trucks to your garage:[/p][list][*][p][b]Super Duty F-450[/b], a humble workhouse that can handle the hardships of a days-long journey without a single hiccup.[/p][/*][*][p][b]F150 Raptor 2024[/b], a fast and powerful offroad beast well-known for its outstanding reliability, especially in desert condition[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/a82f5afbd8c0578644b5aea2f66a224393aaeb5d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/000215b9af301ae39e55a7204b16915dea25b1a6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/006ac76ac5e356f67e5a7e6c66afe8141194b9cd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/46c9ea7810b03e481bfeba9131d7358dc6ad281f.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]👑 REVEALING ROAD KINGS[/b][/h2][p]We recently revealed Road Kings, our brand-new truck sim coming in 2026, set in the American South.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141130/Road_Kings/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Unlike the MudRunner franchise, which focuses on off-road adventures, Road Kings is all about on-road driving. Take the wheel of powerful semis hauling heavy cargo across highways, cities, and rural areas. 🛣️[/p][p][/p][p]A closed beta is planned![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftestzone.focus-entmt.com%2F" style="button" buttoncolor="#921717"]Sign up here[/url][/p][p][i](Registering doesn’t guarantee access; beta expected in the coming months.)[/i][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//40423242/eac7f622d4f9ba91ac0314c109e086d8d1f27f7a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423242/c6b94046e4b3012f2793d6718398852b72737b28.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Some of you asked if SnowRunner will still be supported. Don’t worry! Road Kings is developed by a separate team, so SnowRunner will continue its journey as usual.[/p][p]For more info, check out our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcommunity.focus-entmt.com%2Ffocus-entertainment%2Froad-kings%2Fblogs%2F252-road-kings-faq"]FAQ [/url]and join the dedicated socials:[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FRoadKingsGame" style="button" buttoncolor="#921717"]X[/url][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FFxWybEqJqw" style="button" buttoncolor="#921717"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h2][b]📬 Stay in touch with us![/b][/h2][p]Whether you’re into SnowRunner, RoadCraft, or Expeditions, our Discord is the hub for all things community![/p][p]👉 [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F2mazpRRATa" style="button" buttoncolor="#6753fd"]Join here[/url][/p][p]
You can also catch us on:[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FPlayRoadCraft" style="button" buttoncolor="#e0b310"]X RoadCraft[/url] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FPlaySnowRunner" style="button"]X SnowRunner[/url][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FMudRunnerVideoGame" style="button" buttoncolor="#3073c0"]Facebook[/url] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fsnowrunnergame%2F" style="button" buttoncolor="#af1dab"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fchannel%2FUCaLdl0827np4QVPESo794og" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff0000"]YouTube[/url] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcommunity.focus-entmt.com%2F" style="button" buttoncolor="#80aadb"]Focus Together[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]That’s it from us for now! [/b][/p][p][b]Enjoy the last days of summer and we’ll see each other in September, drivers! 🌇[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477340/Expeditions_A_MudRunner_Game/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Season 2 Features: Unmanned Ground Vehicle
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Runners![/h2]

Today we’re going to present the new equipment that comes with [b]Season 2: the Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV).[/b] UGVs are widely used in research and exploration due to their ability to operate autonomously or semi-autonomously in environments that may be hazardous, inaccessible, or inefficient for human workers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/c42f5999abcc8ba9c7d407de5f88c5e5370a01ba.png[/img]
UGVs play a critical role in [b]environmental research[/b] by collecting data on ecosystems, climate, and pollution in remote or sensitive areas, aiding in understanding and preserving natural environments. 
In [b]geological and geographical exploration[/b], they assist in mapping terrains, identifying resources like minerals or groundwater, and navigating through challenging spaces like caves or tunnels. 
Additionally, in [b]disaster response research[/b], UGVs are vital for search and rescue operations, assessing damage in hazardous zones, and studying extreme conditions to improve disaster preparedness and mitigation strategies.

In [i]Expeditions[/i], this agile gadget will be your best ally when exploring deep caves, where your truck would not be able to take you. The UGV can explore narrow passages, and it's especially efficient when having to do rock climbing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/5672c472d6881671c8b64586e6a60ebd2d352869.png[/img]
Beware though, as the signal range is limited, like the regular flying drone, but it is possible to increase the range thanks to specific items and specialists. The UGV has 4 different slots to carry resources, and it uses electricity as its source of power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/7fb5a6adc6281d173d9c635ac8a368f2e5563d96.png[/img]
That’s it for today! This is but a taste of what it is to come, you’ll discover more on [b]February 27 when Season 2 releases![/b]

notes.title: Season 2 Features: Snowy Mountains
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Runners! 🚚[/h2]

In today’s blog, we’ll talk about the upcoming map that will be featured in Season 2! This new region is based on the Beskids, a series of mountain ranges in the Carpathians, in Eastern Europe. 🏔️

For the first time in [i]Expeditions[/i], you’ll drive in the snow to conduct the research in these mountains. Snow is different from the mud and rocks you’ve encountered so far in Arizona and in the Carpathians. You don’t want to tank your vehicle in deep snow, so FWD trucks will have an edge here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/e3ac9e14f3a22f04e01431a270eae87ede6313e0.png[/img][i]Beskids in real life[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/c15e25993f41d4a08d93e58c78a28056a6cd6463.jpg[/img][i]Beskids in Expeditions[/i]

Your missions in this new area will include analyzing the wildlife, protecting the zone against poachers and conducting expeditions in the Beskidian Caves!

[h3]One of the map key points is an Observatory that overlooks the valley. 🔭[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/d992cb2933027dcc5be7c4a7f40d4d73d42561c9.jpg[/img]
This region often sees meteorites crashes (hence the observatory), and as you can expect, you’ll have to investigate a meteorite fall. Who knows what you could find? (aliens? nah that would be ridiculous 👽)

[h3]Did you know?[/h3]
[i]Tens of thousands of meteorites enter our planet's atmosphere each day, but most are the size of a grain of rice or smaller. Some of them preserve material from the birth of the Solar System 4.6 billion years ago, so their study helps scientists to better understand the creation of our Universe.[/i]

Setting up the region in the cold Carpathians also justifies the research of meteorites: the cold temperatures helps protect meteorites from the effects of weathering for thousands of years.

This new map is not only an outdoor adventure, [b]caves are back for more underground exploration![/b] We’ll go into further detail about these caves in a later blog. 

We hope you’ll enjoy this new map we cooked for Season 2! You can already test it on the Public Beta Branch and give us your feedback! [b]The official release for Season 2 is set for February 27. [/b]

notes.title: Upcoming Improvements & Roadmap Update
notes.content:

[list]
[*] All players are able to see map exploration.
[*] All players are able to complete objectives and make the quest progress.

Our aim with the game has always been to create an engaging experience for both longtime Runners and newcomers, with a strong identity based on two pillars: exploration and science.

notes.title: How to access Public Beta Branch
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Runners,
[/h2]
If you wish to test upcoming content before it releases, we’re glad to offer you a way to do it with our Steam’s [b]“Public Beta Branch”[/b]. To access it, here is a quick tutorial. 
Your feedback is warmly welcomed!

[b][h2]1. Backup your saves:[/h2][/b]
A prerequisite before participating, we strongly recommend you to backup your game saves. A beta version means contents and saves may not be compatible with Live one. Hence, it is a good thing to backup stored saves to retrieve them once back to Live version and avoid any corruption after testing is completed. 

To do this, you need to follow the following steps:
[list]
[*] Find your game save folder path that looks like “\Steam\userdata\<Your Steam ID3 number>\2477340”. For example it could be “C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\userdata\12345678910\2477340”.
[*] Copy “2477340” folder contents and safely store it (e.g: your local drive) as backup.
[*] Now, you can switch to the beta testing version.
[/list]

[b][h2]2. Switch to the Public Beta Branch:[/h2][/b]
From your Steam client:
[list]
[*] Go to your “Library”, right-click on Expeditions.
[*] Go to "Properties".[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/8978e40bd238c97d1d58ae156f1bf8564ad233cd.png[/img][list]
[*] Go to "Betas"
[*] Enter the following line code under "Private betas" to access the Public Beta Branch branch: [b]IBackedUpMySaves[/b]
[*] Click "check code".
[*] Congrats! You have access to the Public Beta Branch.
[*] Close the window, your game will update automatically.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/ad3762502babc86fec6c506a600ebadcb374fb75.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]3. Switch back to the main branch:[/h2][/b]
After beta testing is completed or you want to move back to Live version, from your Steam client:[list]
[*] Go to your “Library”, right-click on Expeditions.
[*] Go to "Properties".[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/8978e40bd238c97d1d58ae156f1bf8564ad233cd.png[/img][list]
[*] Go to "Betas" and select “None” to disable access to Beta branch.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/ee2a02a5b7434b0d4295808d7b19eb6e0a88f0b2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The version of your game updates to the current Live version.
[*] Copy all files from the backup which you've done to the save folder “2477340” (see backup part).
[*] Have a nice game.
[/list]

notes.title: Status of the game and first update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

[i]Expeditions: A MudRunner Game[/i] has officially been out for two days and we’d like to extend a huge thanks to all of you for the feedback received so far. Everyone in the team is on deck, watching streams, videos, and reading your comments and reviews.

We’re happy to see many of you enjoying [i]Expeditions[/i] and what it’s trying to achieve, although we also are aware and understand that some of you aren’t satisfied with the game's current state.

[h2]Our current priorities[/h2]

Some of your most recurrent feedback is about UI/UX. We cannot overhaul it in one night, but this is a big focal point for the team right now, and it will be improved through several updates. [b]Our first update releases with this message, to bring some immediate improvements.[/b]

We’re also hard at work on bug reports, and today’s patch brings a lot of fixes based on your feedback. Be assured that we’ll continue to squash as many technical issues as we can in the coming updates.

We’ve also noticed many requests for a photo mode in [i]Expeditions[/i], and we’re glad to add it with today’s update. It only needed a few extra days of cooking!

[h2]About the co-op mode[/h2]

The co-op mode, which we talked about before launch, will be added as a free update in the coming months, as part of our regular updates to bring new content and features to the game, the same way we’ve supported [i]SnowRunner[/i] after its release in 2020. 

Co-op is an important feature, for both MudRunner veterans and newcomers. That’s why we want the multiplayer experience in [i]Expeditions[/i] to feel as polished as possible, which means taking a few extra months.

[h2]About[i] Expeditions[/i]’ content[/h2]

Our intentions for [i]Expeditions[/i] was to deliver the same amount of content as [i]SnowRunner[/i] but with a new approach with unpaved lands, access to new gadgets and a focus on exploration. To date, [i]Expeditions[/i] features 80 missions and over 120 side activities, spread across 9 different maps located in 3 different regions. The game has over 30km² of drivable terrain, which is the same size as [i]SnowRunner[/i] at its launch. On top of that, we’re planning to add a lot of new content, missions, vehicles, tools, specialists, maps and more.
If you’re curious, check out our [url=https://youtu.be/UZ5UyiMHNdc]Year Pass & Editions Trailer[/url]

[h2]About SnowRunner support[/h2]

Finally, for those of you worried about the future of[i] SnowRunner[/i], we want to be clear about the fact that [i]Expeditions[/i] offers a different experience, centered on exploration, and isn’t meant to replace [i]SnowRunner[/i] in any way. Both games will receive updates, content and fixes over the course of the year, and we hope you’ll enjoy both for what they have to offer.

[h2]First update out now[/h2]

[b]Our first update is out now on PC, and will follow next week on consoles after going through first parties certifications[/b]. You’ll find the patch notes below.

It’s only the first of a long series of updates, so please keep the feedback coming! We can be found here, as well as on social media and [url=http://discord.gg/snowrunner]Discord[/url]. Our support is also ready to help [url=https://support.focus-entmt.com/hc/en-us/categories/17311255215250-Expeditions-A-MudRunner-Game]here[/url].

See you soon for a new update.

[i]The Expeditions Team[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/d7682ed14a0e59cd7af38aa8ddeadd8d833fccf7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Change List[/h1]

[h2]New feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] Photomode
[/list]

[h3]Crashes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the crash reporter
[*] Mods - Fixed crash when spawning the default truck mod
[*] Fixed crash related to interaction with the modules
[*] Fixed crash related to using the Echo Sounder in the Tutorial 
[*] Fixed crash if specify empty slots for KEY BINDINGS on 'Controls' page and then try to open the 'Control Scheme'
[*] Fixed crash related to selling a module 
[/list]

[h3]Art[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the ground texture had low graphical resolution. The issue was encountered on the first map of the Arizona region.
[*] Fixed soapy landscape textures on ultra settings  
[*] Fixed engine start animation for Afim 1960, Cotco Canyon, Collie Pug trucks to match new sounds
[/list]

[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] A comment from players was taken into account when the Map was not centered on the place where a player will deploy. To address the issue of player confusion when deploying far from the first quest point, the first car's deployment zone list will open immediately, so the camera will center on the car.
[*] Significant changes have been made to all car description variants. Now, the information is structured to display truly important details for a player. Elements have a more comprehensible layout, both in terms of meaning and visual composition. Interactive elements have become more apparent. These modifications have affected all instances of displaying information about the car (the Garage, the Truck store, the Map).
[*] Additionally, improvements have been made to the car card in the store: DLC content display has been added, and layout flaws have been corrected. Now, the card precisely shows the information that is crucial for a player when adding a car to their garage.
[*] Added the ‘Recommend’ label for the Little Colorado region. It’s a sign for novice players that they should start with the easier Little Colorado region and gradually move on to the main quests in Arizona and Carpathians. 
[*] Notification of the scanned area did not disappear after using the radar. Fixed a bug where a notification that the zone had been scanned was left on the screen after using the Radar. Previously, the notification could be cleared by re-entering the menu. Now notification disappears correctly.
[*] The movement between addons in the Garage were blocked after returning from the Codex. Now the controls are fixed and working as usual. 
[*] Improved the layout of the pop ups Completed quest and New task. The interface now uses the patterns defined on the HQ screens, it gives better understanding on rewards.
[*] Trucks, Vehicle addons, Base modules and Specialists are now properly displayed in the Reward pop ups of expeditions, contracts and tasks. Previously players have received these rewards as they should have been, but there was no mention of these rewards in UI.
[*] Improved PROS pop ups 
[*] Added the slider when selecting base modules to build
[*] HQ -  It is possible to open the inventory of the car using the cursor
[*] Garage - Fixed bug when fuel quantity does not change after changing the measurement system
[*] Garage - fixed bug related with unexpected changing the balance when selling/buying items before the expedition
[*] Garage - fixed selection on the truck when a player remove the car in the Garage, the focus shifts to the car above
[*] Disabled installation of sideboards if it cannot be installed on the car
[*] The remaining space for gasoline calculates correctly incase of taking any car without a sideboard, installing it, and buying any amount of fuel
[*] Added treasure icons when using the Metal detector 
[*] D button in the Tire Inflation System screen can be clicked by LMB
[*] In the DLC store it is impossible to switch by Q/E buttons 
[*] Truck engine can be turned off on XboxOne, Xbox X
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Feature: upon exiting to the HQ, all incomplete tasks and contracts will be reset. Previously this led to softlocks: if a player returned to the HQ after completing a contract/task stage with a unique item and then returned to the same map with new expeditions, the unique contract/task item wouldn't respawn, so the player had to restart the contract/task manually.
[*] Increased number of attempts to complete the Echo Sounder minigame to simplify quests for players. We received negative feedback about the difficulty of the minigame where a player has to scan fish.
[*] Upgrades opened with binoculars are not displayed on the map. After fixes, objects discovered with binoculars are displayed on the Map.
[*] Added the key to use the car's honk with the gamepad.
[*] Fixed sound of the Drone’s bad signal. The sound would start when a player wasn't far from a truck. Now a player can understand the signal status from the interface. 
[*] Fixed Seismic Vibrator’s sounds
[*] Tutorial - You can't open a refuel hud in a stage with a refueling truck. At the stage, with the car being refueled and repaired, the HUD opens and immediately closes. You cannot go through a stage without re-entering the main menu (after re-entering, you are thrown to the next stage). 
[*] Minigame Camera - Too many fireflies in the minigame at night. The fireflies VFX were displayed on pictures taken by a player. Sometimes there were so many of them that they covered the entire scene.
[*] Minigame Camera - The completed stage disappears immediately after completing the minigame, without necessity in opening/closing the map.
[*] Minigame Visual Inspection - Removed the CLOSE control from the bottom
[*] PS5 Activities are counted as completed
[/list]

[h3]Economical system issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Repeated installations of DLC allowed a player to endlessly receive money from the sale of DLC trucks. Now uninstalling DLCs removes DLC trucks from the game so the money exploit is not available anymore.
[*] WIP truck frame modules were available for purchase in the garage. Players were able to access the Living and Workshop truck framemodules, even though they were not intended to be available. As a result, players could waste money on the Workshop module without being able to install it. Living Module didn’t have any functionality but was possible to buy and install. Now both frame modules are not available for purchase.
[*] Addon purchase is blocked in case of buying invalid module
[/list]

[h3]Mod support[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added localization in the cheat pop-ups on the Polygon map 
[*] Added the new Expedition’s Readme file in the folder Guides
[*] Fixed bug related to the Mod Browser - The control in the saves screen disappears after remove/installing the mod in the mod browser
[/list]

[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed description of the Expanded parking and Tow truck modules 
[*] Fixed description of consumables in the trade window for the sideboard
[*] Garage - The requirement to open the "Complete _ to unlock" addon is displayed in all supported languages
[*] Removed Korean technical text from the sell button in the Garage 
[*] Fixed cropped texts on Poland, Czech
[/list]

[h3][b]
200+ other minor fixes and improvements [/b][/h3]

notes.title: Discover Expeditions: A Mudrunner Game
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone![/h2]

We're delighted to reveal [i]Expeditions: A MudRunner Game[/i], based on the off-road experience with the most advanced physics by the creators of the critically acclaimed [i]SnowRunner[/i]! 

[previewyoutube=GGEGqbVQnPw;full][/previewyoutube]

With Expeditions, you’ll recognize elements that define the MudRunner experience - untamed lands, difficult terrains, and unprecedented vehicle-driving physics - while pushing the formula even further. As shown in today’s reveal trailer, Expeditions is a real call to adventure, where you’ll utilize newly gadget-packed vehicles and an expert crew to explore uncharted gorgeous landscapes and discover breathtaking landmarks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/d27a10507fc42bc958f4128ecf58d3d513d128bc.jpg[/img]

[h2]A MudRunner Game. And way more.[/h2]

Embark on ever-rewarding scientific expeditions as you adapt to nature's challenges and unravel the mysteries of uncharted lands. Venture into the vast wilderness of arid deserts and rugged forests to the steepest mountains, brimming with hidden treasures and forgotten ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536069/833cab6994ea4815cf57e9840a4f4357ba828ab3.jpg[/img]

Lead research missions as you drive a variety of all-terrain vehicles through treacherous paths, using advanced technologies and high-tech tools to overcome obstacles. Build and manage your base and equip your vehicles with essential gadgets like drones or scanners to ensure your success in the wild. Round out your Expedition by hiring a team of top-notch experts to improve your skills in the field, unlocking new possibilities for exploration.

[list]
[*]   Experience a new take on the most advanced physics-based, off-road adventure from the creators of MudRunner and SnowRunner.
[*]   Plan your itinerary wisely by flying over the landscapes with your reconnaissance drone, use your metal detector and camera drone to locate caches of valuable equipment.
[*]   Chart through extreme landscapes with your vehicle's arsenal of cutting-edge gadgets, like planting anchors to ascend difficult slopes or activating echo sounders to probe water depth.
[*]   Manage your camp by building research structures and hiring experts to unlock new skills and possibilities during your expeditions.
[/list]
